vulnerabilities.description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE (component: AWT, JavaFX). Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u471, 8u471-b50, 8u471-perf, 11.0.29, 17.0.17, 21.0.9, 25.0.1; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.17 and 21.0.9; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.16. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. Successful attacks require human interaction from a person other than the attacker and while the vulnerability is in Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change). Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data or all Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required for the Liquibase Secure container. The image uses Temurin JRE and does not run as a sandboxed Java client.

ratings.justification: The assessed image is a Linux CLI container built on Temurin JRE, not an Oracle Java SE/GraalVM client runtime with AWT/JavaFX applet or Web Start exposure.

analysis.detail: Oracle Java SE AWT/JavaFX sandbox vulnerability. Liquibase Secure is built from eclipse-temurin:21-jre-noble (core/docker/Dockerfile:1), not an Oracle Java SE or GraalVM client distribution. The container runs the Liquibase CLI through docker-entrypoint.sh rather than a sandboxed Java Web Start or applet environment (core/docker/docker-entrypoint.sh:8), so the client-only runtime required by the advisory is absent.

vulnerabilities.description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE (component: Security). Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 8u501, 11.0.32, 17.0.20, 21.0.12, 25.0.4, 26.0.2; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.20 and 21.0.12; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.19. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized read access to a subset of Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition accessible data. Note: This vulnerability can only be exploited by supplying data to APIs in the specified Component without using Untrusted Java Web Start applications or Untrusted Java applets, such as through a web service. vulnerabilities.recommendation: No immediate action required given the narrow, trusted-endpoint- compromise precondition. Track Eclipse Temurin's release of a 21-jre- noble image containing 21.0.12.1+1 and rebuild once available.

ratings.justification: Vulnerable JVM networking/TLS code is in Liquibase's execute path (outbound HTTPS/TLS JDBC client), but exploitation requires the attacker to already control or compromise a trusted peer -- not reachable by an arbitrary remote attacker with no foothold there.

analysis.detail: JDK Security component (resource resolving) vulnerability, part of Oracle's August 2026 CPU. Liquibase Secure is built from eclipse- temurin:21-jre-noble (docker/Dockerfile:2) and never listens on a socket; it is only an outbound network client (HTTPS to license/hub endpoints, TLS JDBC to target databases). Triggering this requires a compromised or MITM'd peer that Liquibase already trusts and connects to -- not exploitable by an arbitrary remote attacker with no foothold on those endpoints. Fixed upstream in Temurin 21.0.12.1+1, but no eclipse- temurin Docker Hub image publishes that build yet as of 2026-09-22 (all noble/jre/jdk tags remain 21.0.12_8); revisit once Temurin ships an updated 21-jre-noble tag.

vulnerabilities.description: Vulnerability in the Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Java SE (component: JSSE). Supported versions that are affected are Oracle Java SE: 11.0.31, 17.0.19, 21.0.11, 25.0.3, 26.0.1; Oracle GraalVM for JDK: 17.0.19 and 21.0.11; Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition: 21.3.18. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via TLS to compromise Oracle Java SE, Oracle GraalVM for JDK, Oracle GraalVM Enterprise Edition. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service (partial DOS). Note: This vulnerability can only be exploited by supplying data to APIs in the specified Component without using Untrusted Java Web Start applications or Untrusted Java applets, such as through a web service.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required for the Liquibase Secure container. This image is an outbound client, not a sandboxed Java runtime exposed to arbitrary TLS peers.

ratings.justification: Exploitation requires a malicious or compromised TLS peer already in the trusted outbound path. The Liquibase Secure container is not a server or sandboxed Java client runtime.

analysis.detail: Oracle Java JSSE partial-denial-of-service issue. The scan reported Oracle OpenJDK 21.0.11+10-LTS, but Liquibase Secure uses a Temurin 21 JRE base and runs only as an outbound CLI client to trusted HTTPS and JDBC endpoints, not as a server or a sandboxed Java client runtime. Exploitation requires a malicious or compromised TLS peer already in the trusted network path, which is outside the expected deployment environment for this image.

ratings.justification: CNA (Oracle) score; NVD had not yet published its own score at assessment time.
The vulnerable component (Oracle's Java installer) is not present in the Liquibase Secure image; the container runs a Temurin JRE unpacked from a release archive.

analysis.detail: Oracle Java SE/GraalVM Install-component vulnerability, fixed upstream in 21.0.12 (Oracle August 2026 CPU). The flaw is in Oracle's Java installer, a packaging component that ships only with Oracle's own distribution. Liquibase Secure is built from eclipse-temurin:21-jre-noble (core/docker/Dockerfile:1) via docker-entrypoint.sh (core/docker/docker-entrypoint.sh:8); Temurin's JRE is unpacked from a release archive, not installed through Oracle's installer, so the vulnerable component is not present in the image at all. There is no Adoptium/Temurin tracking entry for this CVE. Unlike the other Oracle Java SE entries in this batch (sandbox/Web Start applicability mismatches, justified requires_environment), this is a component absence -- the installer isn't shipped at all -- hence code_not_present.
